skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of international accounting, including its formation and development, diversity, and factors influencing its development.
Understand the differences in financial reporting in multinational companies and apply methods for converting and consolidating international financial reports.
Understand international taxation and transfer pricing methods for multinational companies.
Develop skills in critical thinking, analysis, evaluation, and decision-making in accounting.
Improve communication skills, including writing reports and giving professional presentations.
Enhance ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic work environment.
Apply problem-solving skills to various accounting scenarios in multinational companies.
Conduct research on international accounting systems and factors influencing their development.
Demonstrate personal responsibility and accountability in both individual and group work.
